Title: Public Preview: Time-travel for Azure Synapse Link for Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Time-Travel allows you to access Cosmos DB data as it appeared at a specific point of time in the history. With this feature, you can rewind to read previous transactions in Synapse Link containers to analyze previous versions of your documents. This can be useful in time series analytics, auditing data changes, reproducing experiments, reports, and rollbacks.  Time-travel for Azure Synapse Link is available in Apache Spark in Azure Synapse Analytics, for both NoSQL and MongoDB APIs.
